preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The maximum path length l must be at least 1 and at most n.
The maximum path weight w must be between 0 and 1,000,000,000.
The number of edges must be exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= pi < (i + 1) for i, (pi, wi) in enumerate(edges))
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect vertex (i + 1) to a vertex pi where pi is less than (i + 1).

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= wi <= 10**4 for _, wi in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge weight wi must be between 0 and 10,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of close pairs of vertices as a string.
